# Northwestern Now News

> Northwestern University's comprehensive news platform covering cutting-edge research, faculty expertise, and institutional updates across science, health, business, and policy domains.

Northwestern Now serves as the official news hub for Northwestern University, aggregating stories about faculty research, student achievements, and institutional developments. The platform organizes content through topic-based hubs and research categories, making it a key resource for journalists, researchers, and the broader Northwestern community.

## Key Topics

- Northwestern University
- Research and Innovation
- Artificial Intelligence
- Wearable Technology
- Health and Medicine
- Cancer Research
- Neuroscience
- Business and Entrepreneurship
- Economics
- Public Health
- Sustainability and Environment
- Space Exploration
- Faculty Experts
- SuperAgers
- Medill School

## Core News & Navigation

- [Northwestern Now News](https://news.northwestern.edu): Northwestern University's main news homepage featuring latest updates and announcements.
- [Topics Directory](https://news.northwestern.edu/topics): Topic directory and content taxonomy for browsing Northwestern news by subject.
- [News Stories Archive](https://news.northwestern.edu/stories): Archive of Northwestern news stories and announcements from 2026.

## Research & Innovation Hubs

- [Health & Medicine](https://news.northwestern.edu/research-and-innovation/health-and-medicine): Health and medicine research hub featuring Feinberg breakthroughs and discoveries.
- [Science & Technology](https://news.northwestern.edu/research-and-innovation/science-and-technology): Science and technology advances and research updates from Northwestern.
- [Business, Media & Politics](https://news.northwestern.edu/research-and-innovation/culture-politics-and-business): Research hub covering business, media and politics at Northwestern University.

## Science & Technology Topics

- [Artificial Intelligence](https://news.northwestern.edu/topics/artificial-intelligence): Topic hub for Northwestern AI research, machine learning and applications.
- [Wearable Technology](https://news.northwestern.edu/topics/wearable-technology): Topic hub for Northwestern wearable tech and bioelectronics research by John Rogers.
- [Space](https://news.northwestern.edu/topics/space): Topic hub for Northwestern astronomy and space research including Webb Telescope.
- [Environment](https://news.northwestern.edu/topics/environment): Topic hub covering Northwestern sustainability, climate and environmental research.

## Health & Life Sciences Topics

- [Brain](https://news.northwestern.edu/topics/brain): Topic hub for Northwestern neuroscience research on brain health and disease.
- [Cancer](https://news.northwestern.edu/topics/cancer): Topic hub for Northwestern cancer research and treatment breakthroughs.
- [Aging](https://news.northwestern.edu/topics/aging): Topic hub for Northwestern aging research including SuperAgers and Alzheimer's studies.
- [Public Health](https://news.northwestern.edu/topics/public-health): Topic hub for Northwestern public health and disease prevention research.

## Business, Policy & Media Topics

- [Economics](https://news.northwestern.edu/topics/economics): Topic hub for Northwestern economics research including Nobel Prize-winning faculty.
- [Business](https://news.northwestern.edu/topics/business): Topic hub for Northwestern business research on entrepreneurship and workplace issues.
- [Politics](https://news.northwestern.edu/topics/politics): Topic hub for Northwestern political research and policy analysis.
- [Media](https://news.northwestern.edu/topics/media): Topic hub for Northwestern journalism and media innovation from Medill School.

## Media & Journalist Resources

- [For Journalists](https://news.northwestern.edu/for-journalists): Journalist resources including Faculty Experts database and news release archive.
- [Northwestern in the News](https://news.northwestern.edu/in-the-news): Roundup of Northwestern faculty and research coverage in major media outlets.
